note: Repo-scoped adaptation of the fleet's canonical secrets manifest, per the repo-config downstream carry. This repo publishes a multi-arch Docker image to Docker Hub (static secrets; Docker Hub has no OIDC equivalent) plus GitHub releases (no credentials), and uploads coverage to Codecov, so the fleet baseline applies plus the docker-hub and codecov mechanisms. AUDIT.md cross-checks these names (values are never read).

baseline.note: The App-token secrets power the App-signed merge-bot (auto-merge that re-triggers downstream workflows), which every fleet repo runs; also consumed by codegen and the upstream-version tracker where present. Used via actions/create-github-app-token with the client-id input (not the deprecated app-id). The CODEGEN_* name is historical, not codegen-specific.

codecov.note: CODECOV_TOKEN is listed in the registry requiredSecrets (unlike the implicit baseline secrets). Both stores: a workflow run triggered by a Dependabot PR reads the Dependabot secrets store, so without that copy the coverage upload silently skips on every bot PR. Coverage upload is report-only (fail_ci_if_error: false), so a Codecov hiccup never fails the gate.
